changelog.notes: Legacy trial exported from Video-based Product Ranking Tool (VPRT) survey records into release schema v2.0.

study.title: Video-based product concept testing of groundnut seed products, Tanzania
study.description: Farmers watched short videos presenting three of the product concepts, assigned at random (incomplete block design), and named the concept they would most and least like to acquire. Part of 'Video-based Product Ranking Tool (VPRT) as a basis for groundnut, maize, and sorghum market segmentation' (CIMMYT market intelligence, v1.1, 2025-04-29). Source data: Rutsaert P, Mawia H (2024). Using a Video-based Product Ranking Tool (VPRT) as a basis for market segmentation in Tanzania (Groundnut). CIMMYT Research Data & Software Repository Network, V1. https://hdl.handle.net/11529/10549104
study.objective: market segmentation and product profile design

location_privacy.method: Site coordinates rounded to two decimals (a cell of about 1.1 km), so the published point lies within 800 m of the recorded one and neighbouring sites share a point. Sites without coordinates take the mean of other sites in the same adm3 before rounding.
location_privacy.admin_names: Administrative names kept, with spacing and capitalisation standardised

data_producer.name: International Maize and Wheat Improvement Center (CIMMYT)

genotypes.description: 'Snacking variety'. Great flavour for roasting, salting or boiling, sold by local sellers on the roadside. Ready in 115-120 days.
'Early maturity variety'. Harvest after 100-110 days instead of 115-120 to avoid drought, with lower yield than average in normal seasons.
'Dual-purpose variety'. Larger, more abundant leaves and stems as livestock forage, about 25% lower nut yield. Ready in 115-120 days.
'High nutritional variety'. Highest nutritional value (protein, fats, vitamins, fibre, minerals) for children, pregnant women and people with health challenges. Ready in 115-120 days.
'High oil variety'. Very high oil content for oil processors, possibly a higher price, less useful for home consumption, snacking or paste. Ready in 100-120 days.
'Home cooking variety'. For snacking, stew and paste; oil content suited to these uses; pods easy to shell but not fragile. Ready in 115-120 days.
'Industrial processor variety'. Demanded by larger buyers for industrial paste; harder shell, difficult to shell at home. Ready in 115-120 days.
'Intercropping variety'. Performs well alternated with maize, pigeon pea or other crops. Ready in 115-120 days.
'Low labor variety'. Early vigour that suppresses weeds and a compact root system that eases harvesting. Ready in 115-120 days.
'Drought resistant variety'. Higher yield than neighbours under sporadic or low rainfall, similar yield in good seasons. Ready in 115-120 days.

variables.description: Site identifier, trial id plus package number
Trial identifier. ClimMob v3 project id, or for legacy trials 11 hex characters plus 'v' (see decisions)
Country, ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 code
Country name
Crop tested in the trial
Longitude in decimal degrees (WGS84), rounded to two decimals to protect participants
Latitude in decimal degrees (WGS84), rounded to two decimals to protect participants
Where the original coordinate was taken (farm, interview point, adm3 mean of other sites, missing, removed)
Radius in metres around the published point that contains the original point (displacement plus spread of the sites used for gap filling)
Check of the original coordinate against the country boundary (ok, near_border, missing, outside, swapped_candidate, sign_flip_candidate)
Gender of the participant
Age of the participant in years at registration
Highest level of education of the participant
Civil status or position in the household of the participant
Number of persons in the household
Number of household members below 18 years of age
Whether the household keeps livestock
Why the participant chose the most preferred concept, one or more options of a fixed list, separated by '; '
Why the participant chose the least preferred concept, one or more options of a fixed list, separated by '; '
Site identifier, links to site_data
Plot letter within the site (A, B, C)
Name of the genotype (variety) in the plot
Data collection moment (form) as named in the trial
Planned day of the collection moment, counted from the start of the trial as set in the trial design (the day of sowing in most designs); the same for every site. The actual date is moment_date
Day the form of the collection moment was filled in or submitted for the site (YYYY-MM-DD), the actual date of the observation; null when the source has none or the form was typed in after the season
Variable name, harmonised across trials
Identifier of the harmonised question
Question code or label as used in the trial
Value. For value_type rank, 1 is best and 3 is worst
rank, vs_local, numeric, date, categorical, multiple or text
Unit of numeric values. Yield values refer to the entire plot
Quality flag (implausible_yield_per_area, outlier_vs_trial_median, unit_unclear, derived)
Farmer ranking (1 best, 3 worst): Preference among video-presented product concepts: the concept the farmer would most and least like to acquire if it were available
